notes: eDP characterization centers on the embedded Main Link PHY (eye, jitter, swing/pre-emphasis, reduced-swing) over the internal flex, the AUX channel (Manchester-II timing), EDID/DPCD access (incl. the eDP-specific block), Fast Link Training, PSR entry/exit latency with the RFB, and backlight-over-AUX. Conformance is established by the VESA eDP / DisplayPort Compliance Test Specification (CTS); per-panel PHY calibration is done at bring-up.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Main Link eye diagram per rate
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify the differential NRZ eye meets the budget at RBR/HBR/HBR2/HBR3 (8b/10b) over the internal flex channel.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Voltage swing / pre-emphasis
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm the 4 swing and 4 pre-emphasis levels (and the reduced-swing option) and their bounded combinations.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Clock recovery / jitter
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm the panel Sink CDR locks (CR_DONE) and meets jitter tolerance at each rate.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Fast Link Training
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm the stored-settings FLT achieves lock for the fixed channel and the fallback to full CR/EQ works.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: AUX channel timing
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Validate Manchester-II ~1 Mbps request/reply timing and half-duplex turnaround.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: EDID read
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm I2C-over-AUX panel EDID retrieval (I2C address A0h).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: PSR entry/exit latency
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Measure Panel Self Refresh entry, self-refresh, and exit timing (RFB) and PSR2 selective-update latency.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Backlight over AUX
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm backlight brightness control over AUX and the PWM generator frequency / resolution.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Compliance (CTS)
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Run the VESA eDP / DisplayPort Compliance Test Specification link/PHY/AUX/PSR/backlight suite.
